note: Schema documents describe the authoring contract. They are documentation: the loader skips content/schemas/ and they do not affect the catalog hash.

units.power: integer power-unit milli-units; power is never a stored commodity
units.no_floating_point: the loader rejects fractional and exponent literals outright

identifiers: lowercase ASCII letters, digits and underscore; 1..64 characters

fields.simulation_version: must match the build that loads the catalog
fields.civilian_needs: per-resident Food, Water and residential power per day
fields.wellbeing: health, fatigue and stability movement limits and weights
fields.condition: condition bounds, maintenance movement and the Service Facility command
fields.construction: power per assigned worker and the global minimum build days
fields.workforce: transfer delays from Reserve and between occupied jobs
fields.news: shortage hysteresis, milestone thresholds and retention limits
